answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before its votes count, then slash that stake when a randomly selected audit finds duplicate control or fabricated work. Auditors compare costly, time-bound tasks and shared signing patterns; a raven can flag a suspicious cluster, while a beacon publishes audit proofs so others can verify them. The delta between expected reward and the chance of losing stake must make each extra fake identity uneconomic: the attacker pays capital and audit risk for every account, not just a cheap registration fee.
